description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 1829/11 of 23.09.2013, Rathmalana D/S Division and other amendments
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with amendments to land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains multiple entries detailing specific corrections and modifications to land parcel records, including changes to parcel numbers, land extents, ownership details, title classifications, and encumbrances. The content is published in "PART III - LANDS" and focuses entirely on land title settlement matters, making it a clear example of Land Gazette classification.
